# Delete Greatest Value in Each Row.

@example Sorted, the rows are 7,5,1 and 6,2,2: the rounds add 7, 5 and 2.
[[5,1,7],[2,6,2]]
=> 14

@example One number per row: a single round, which adds the largest.
[[3],[9],[4]]
=> 9

@example A single row adds every one of its numbers.
[[8,8,1]]
=> 17

# The smallest grid, at both bounds of the numbers.
[[1]]
=> 1

[[100]]
=> 100

# All numbers equal.
[[4,4],[4,4],[4,4]]
=> 8

# Repeats inside a row are given up one copy per round: 6+6+6+5.
[[6,6,6,1],[5,5,5,5]]
=> 23

# Rows that are each other's reverse: the column maxima would add to 14.
[[1,2,3,4],[4,3,2,1]]
=> 10

# The rows take turns giving the round's largest: 10, 9, then 3 and 3.
[[10,1,9,2],[8,7,3,3]]
=> 25

[[9,1,5],[2,8,6],[7,3,4]]
=> 18

# One row wins every round.
[[50,40,30],[1,2,3]]
=> 120

# Fifty rows of one number: the largest of them, 89.

=> 89
